steps.reason_for_choice: The stopping rule allows stopping: a feasible current lowest-cost candidate exists, no unresolved candidate remains after optimizing all candidates, and the Ru-vs-Fe parity/reachability classification is complete. Remaining affordable actions have low expected decision value for the nominal industrial decision; they would mostly refine already-quantified uncertainty or scenario sensitivities.

llm_state_before.updated_belief: S1 is satisfied by feasible Fe at the lowest nominal optimized cost. S2 is satisfied because every candidate has been optimized on the full window. S3 is satisfied: highest-activity Ru differs from Fe, but Ru would need 201.2x intrinsic activity for cost parity and only up to 2.52x is available across process states on the frozen descriptor manifold, so parity by intrinsic activity is unreachable. Remaining uncertainty risk is descriptor uncertainty, where the 300-draw MC gives Fe P(lowest)=0.69 and Ru P(lowest)=0.31 among the feasible set; this affects robustness, not the nominal canonical-cost decision.

chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 Fe is feasible and has the lowest nominal full-window optimized canonical cost; S2 every candidate was optimized on the full process window, leaving no unresolved candidates; S3 Ru is the highest atomic-activity candidate but its required activity gain for Fe cost parity was computed and classified unreachable on the frozen descriptor scaling manifold. Further affordable actions have low expected value for changing the nominal industrial decision.

unresolved_decision_risk.nominal_model_risk: Fe optimum has Tsep at the upper admissible edge (30 C), so the admissible domain boundary sets that variable; Ru and Os optima have T at the upper admissible edge (450 C). These do not invalidate the full-domain comparison but indicate boundary-constrained optima.
unresolved_decision_risk.uncertainty_risk: Descriptor-uncertainty MC with 300 draws gives Fe P(lowest)=0.69 and Ru P(lowest)=0.31 among Fe/Ru/Os, so Fe is the nominal deterministic winner but not overwhelmingly robust to descriptor uncertainty.
unresolved_decision_risk.model_floor_risk: Ru and Os optimized bed volumes are below the 0.3 m3 vessel-correlation floor and were costed with the declared clamp; this favors neither enough to beat Fe nominally.
